reason: I don't have the capacity to think about this right now. I bill cost-plus, so I'd only add it if a homeowner agrees to pay, and I'm not going to chase that for $1,500 a home.
objection: I'd be eating the cost or fighting the homeowner over a new line item, and my team already has plans, a designer and Parade-style renderings. Another vendor to manage isn't worth it.
would_change_my_mind: A homeowner or my designer asking for it by name and agreeing in writing to pay it as a pass-through, or seeing it close a sale on a spec home.
